metadata.title: एससी-एसटी आयोग की गायब रिपोर्ट | SC/ST Commissions: Failing the Mandate | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
The National Commissions for Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Castes were established to safeguard the rights and interests of India’s most marginalised communities. These constitutional bodies are mandated to submit annual reports to the President—reports that are meant to be tabled in Parliament.

These reports play a crucial role in influencing policies and laws that directly impact Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Castes. But disturbingly, these commissions are failing in this essential duty. Year after year, the reports are either delayed, incomplete, or not submitted at all.

This serious lapse undermines not only the constitutional mandate but also the voice and visibility of the very communities these commissions are meant to serve.

In this special episode, Main Bhi Bharat delves into what's going wrong, why these lapses are occurring, and what the consequences are for the ST and SC communities across the country.

Join us as we uncover the accountability crisis within these powerful institutions—and why fixing it is urgent for a just and inclusive democracy.

#DalitLivesMatter #SocialJustice #ConstitutionalRights #MarginalisedVoices  #HumanRightsIndia
